author: CMDJojo
body:
Hello Avicus!
My name is CMDJojo. I have been banned from your network a long time ago because I flew. I agree to that I've cheated. I flew in one nebula game because I wanted to test if your server had an anti-hack system. I know that I did wrong, and I know that it was dumb by me. I really like your games, especially nebula, and I really want to play more. So right now, I'm begging of a second chanse of playing on your servers. I know that it was dumb by me of testing the hacks, and I've learnt something from this. I know that it would be hard to send in a hacker, but I promise to not cheat on servers again. Please, please, at least think of unban me...

Thank you for even reading this.
From CMDJojo

replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the amount of time you have been banned, I will accept your appeal. However, if you are banned again, your chances of appeal again will be significantly lower. Remember to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back.

Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
